# Mini Source Register

4 sources. Tier 1 = primary/official/normative, 2 = peer reviewed, 3 = transparent preprint or open artifact, 4 = commercial or observational, 5 = anecdotal.

| ID | Tier | Accessed | Source | Use | Limitations |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| S-001 | T1 | 2026-01-28 | Example Planter Docs, [Planter settings reference](https://docs.planter.example/planter/settings) | Normative statement of how the reference planter stores its watering intervals. | Documents the planter's own defaults only; says nothing about growth. |
| S-002 | T2 | 2026-01-28 | Example Leaf Journal, [A controlled study of light level and leaf growth](https://journals.leaf.example/2024/light-study) | The only measured effect size for a light change in this base. | Single lab study, 42 cuttings, one cultivar. |
| S-003 | T3 | 2026-01-29 | Windowsill Notes, [Growing pothos at home](https://blog.windowsill-notes.example/pothos-at-home) | Practitioner report on interval units and on where light starts to scorch leaves. | Signed but unreviewed; one grower, one windowsill. |
| S-004 | T4 | 2026-01-30 | PlantLog, [Home growing telemetry report](https://analytics.plantlog.example/reports/growing) | Commercial telemetry on event-level watering data. | Vendor's own aggregate; sampling frame undisclosed. |
